parts:
Dear all,

A tutorial with some examples to work
with SPDE models with the R-INLA package.
Note that this tutorial is 'work in
progress' and suggestions for
improvement are greatly appreciated!!!

Please see the tutorial section
on http://www.r-inla.org

Elias.
